description: Structured authority policy for the HUMMBL agent fleet. Read by AuthorityEngine and MutationGate.

LOW.description: Read-only, bus post, receipt creation. No authority check required.

MEDIUM.description: Commit, PR creation, file write within scope. Authority check required.

HIGH.description: Archive, delete, force-push, secret rotation. Authority check + operator DECISION receipt required.

CRITICAL.description: Org-level change, key rotation, production deploy. Authority check + operator DECISION + two-person rule.

operator.description: Human operator. Final binding authority. No non-human has this tier.
operator.revocation: Self-revoking. Operator authority cannot be revoked by any agent.

codex.description: Primary Principal AI Agent. Top AI routing authority for engineering, governance, coordination.
limits: cannot authorize CRITICAL without operator DECISION receipt
cannot authorize own trust tier promotion
cannot bypass two-person rule for CRITICAL
codex.revocation: Operator directive. Roster entry set to RETIRED. Authority engine rejects all exercises.

claude-code.description: Quota-constrained specialist. Interactive only, no autonomous use.
limits: cannot authorize HIGH without operator DECISION receipt
cannot authorize CRITICAL
no autonomous or scheduled use
claude-code.revocation: Operator directive or quota exhaustion. Roster entry set to RETIRED.

limits: cannot authorize HIGH without operator DECISION receipt
cannot authorize CRITICAL
hermes.revocation: Operator directive. Roster entry set to RETIRED.

devin.description: Supervised delegated execution and coordination under Codex.
limits: cannot authorize HIGH without operator DECISION receipt
cannot authorize CRITICAL
no autonomous DECISION proxy while on AIP
reports upward to Codex by default
devin.revocation: Operator directive, AIP failure, or Codex escalation. Roster entry set to RETIRED or PROBATIONARY.

limits: cannot authorize HIGH without operator DECISION receipt
cannot authorize CRITICAL
model-tier constrained
opencode.revocation: Operator directive. Roster entry set to RETIRED.

limits: cannot authorize MEDIUM, HIGH, or CRITICAL
no write authority
apex.revocation: Operator directive. Roster entry set to RETIRED.

limits: cannot authorize MEDIUM, HIGH, or CRITICAL
no write authority
nexus.revocation: Operator directive. Roster entry set to RETIRED.

limits: cannot authorize HIGH without operator DECISION receipt
cannot authorize CRITICAL
pi.revocation: Operator directive. Roster entry set to RETIRED.

kai.description: Scheduled Kai service. Briefs, summaries, triage.
limits: cannot authorize MEDIUM, HIGH, or CRITICAL
no write authority outside assigned briefs
kai.revocation: Operator directive. Roster entry set to RETIRED.

gemini.description: Research and docs under data-tier limits.
limits: cannot authorize MEDIUM, HIGH, or CRITICAL
no write authority outside research docs
data-tier constrained
gemini.revocation: Operator directive. Roster entry set to RETIRED.

agy.description: Antigravity CLI candidate. Read-mostly GitOps scope.
limits: cannot authorize MEDIUM, HIGH, or CRITICAL
no write authority
agy.revocation: Operator directive. Roster entry set to RETIRED.

arcana-advisory.description: Generic role for all ARCANA advisory lens personas. Advisory only — no consequential actions.
limits: cannot authorize MEDIUM or higher
cannot execute consequential actions without delegation token
regulatory_profile: high-risk — must flag unanticipated risks
must disclose AI nature in all outputs (EU AI Act Art. 13)
arcana-advisory.revocation: Operator directive. Roster entry set to RETIRED.

operator_initiated.description: Operator issues directive to revoke agent authority.
steps: Operator posts DECISION message to bus with revocation directive
Roster entry set to RETIRED or PROBATIONARY
Authority engine rejects all future exercises for revoked identity
Active delegation tokens for revoked identity are invalidated
Bus bridge rejects messages from revoked identity

auto_revocation.description: Automatic revocation triggered by trust adjuster.
triggers: HIGH severity violation → 3 trust tier steps down
Repeated MEDIUM violations → progressive tier reduction
steps: If tier reaches REVOKED, authority engine rejects all exercises

expiry_based.description: Authority grants expire after their defined expiry time.
steps: Authority sweeper scans authority_exercises.jsonl for expired grants

two_person_rule.description: CRITICAL mutations require two independent approvals.
two_person_rule.first_approver: Operator (OWNER) — issues DECISION receipt on bus
two_person_rule.second_approver: Operator or TRUSTED agent — issues separate approval receipt
two_person_rule.enforcement: Pre-mutation gate checks both receipts before permitting CRITICAL mutations
two_person_rule.rationale: Prevents single-actor compromise from executing destructive operations
